validation.test_result: All 20 listed checks exited successfully. The Studio suite reported 1018 cases and 46277 assertions.

tested_behavior: A real headless ImGui click on the timeline table Delete control routes through DrawTimelineKeyDelete and the canonical document-edit transaction.
Deletion covers a physical shared key and a retired shared-alias key. The retired case retains the current owner's key and detached metadata while clearing the selected detached value key.
Native Write/Read roundtrip and RestoreSourceAnimatorBindings accept the resulting document.
Undo restores the exact prior document and Redo restores the deleted result.
History refusal leaves the document unchanged.
The legacy local-key case remains local and does not create SourceAnimators state.
